title: collection.rs test name 'is_complete_false_when_total_unknown' is wrong: test actually verifies gap detection
description: collection.rs:413-426: The test is named is_complete_false_when_total_unknown but its comment says 'The test intent from the bead: false when total unknown — but with our auto-bump logic total becomes known'. The test actually creates a gap scenario (adds parts 1 and 3, skips 2) to get is_complete()=false. There is no test that verifies the pre-auto-bump behaviour of PartCollection::new(). The test name should be is_complete_false_with_gap, and a separate test should cover the new()-without-add case (where total is truly None and is_complete() must return false).
